empty_states.no_matter_selected: Choose a matter to see review status, blockers, and next steps.
empty_states.no_documents_uploaded: Upload a document to start review, evidence mapping, or timeline work.
empty_states.no_sources_retrieved: No sources have been retrieved yet. Ask a question or add source cards to continue.
empty_states.no_verified_citations: No citations are verified yet. Run citation verification before relying on a citation.
empty_states.no_quote_spans_verified: No quote spans are verified yet. Run quote verification before relying on quoted text.
empty_states.no_evidence_mapped: No evidence has been mapped yet. Add facts and supporting records to continue.
empty_states.draft_blocked_from_filing_ready: This draft stays blocked until source, citation, quote, fact, form, posture, and human review checks pass.
empty_states.source_freshness_unknown: Source freshness is unknown. Current-law language must stay limited until freshness is verified.
empty_states.attorney_review_not_complete: Attorney or qualified human review is not complete yet.
empty_states.external_pilot_signoff_missing: External pilot and signoff evidence is still missing. Internal passes do not replace those gates.

blocked_states.unsupported_claim: This claim does not have enough verified source support yet.
blocked_states.citation_not_found: A citation could not be found in the current source set.
blocked_states.citation_unverified: A citation has not been verified yet against a source card.
blocked_states.quote_span_not_found: The quoted language was not verified in a source span.
blocked_states.source_unknown_freshness: Source freshness is unknown, so current-law language stays limited.
blocked_states.source_stale: A source appears stale and must be re-verified before relying on it.
blocked_states.jurisdiction_mismatch: The available sources do not clearly match the needed jurisdiction.
blocked_states.review_required: Human review is still required before relying on this output.
blocked_states.human_review_missing: Required human review has not been completed.
blocked_states.attorney_pilot_evidence_missing: Attorney sandbox pilot evidence is not present yet.
blocked_states.external_signoff_missing: External legal, product, security, or ops signoff is not present yet.
blocked_states.blocked_from_filing_ready: The filing-ready gate has not passed.
